description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Who is this wallet: label exchange / whale / active_trader / fresh_wallet / dormant, 0-100 activity score with reasons, native + USDC balance, tx count, first/last activity, exchange label and whale transfer history. Chains ethereum, base, solana. Computed from raw chain RPC. Returns JSON label, 0-100 activity score, balances, activity dates, exchange label, and whale-transfer history.

address.description: Wallet address on that chain. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a Solana public key when chain is solana. Example: 0x28C6c06298d514Db089934071355E5743bf21d60. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain of the wallet. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: ethereum. Allowed values: ethereum, base, solana.

name: wallet_profile
title: Wallet profile ($0.005)
